executor_address.description: Account address used to execute the script; must be a valid bech32 address.

script_address.description: Script bech32 address to execute; mutually exclusive with script_name.

script_name.description: Optional nameservice name of the script to execute (e.g., "example.dys").

extra_code.description: Optional extra code temporarily appended to the script for this execution. Only allowed if the executor is the script owner.

function_name.description: Name of the function to call within the script.

args.description: Positional arguments (*args) encoded as a JSON array.

kwargs.description: Keyword arguments (**kwargs) encoded as a JSON object.

type_url.description: The type url prefixed with a slash, like '/cosmos.bank.v1beta1.MsgSend'

value.description: Must be a valid serialized protocol buffer of the above specified type.

items.title: Any
items.description: Contains the serialized protocol buffer message using the response bytes from `/dysonprotocol.script.v1.QueryEncodeJsonRequest`

attached_messages.description: Messages executed before the script; results available but state changes discarded.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.RunScript.title: Run Script
dysonprotocol.script.v1.RunScript.description: RunScript requests execution of a script function in read-only mode. Similar to MsgExec but executed in a cached context with no persistent state changes. All execution results are returned but any state modifications are discarded.

result.description: Execution result returned by the script function.

type_url.description: The type url prefixed with a slash, like '/cosmos.bank.v1beta1.MsgSend'

value.description: Must be a valid serialized protocol buffer of the above specified type.

items.title: Any
items.description: Contains the serialized protocol buffer message using the response bytes from `/dysonprotocol.script.v1.QueryEncodeJsonRequest`

attached_message_results.description: Results of the attached messages executed before the script.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.ResponseRunScrip.title: Response Run Script
dysonprotocol.script.v1.ResponseRunScrip.description: ResponseRunScript contains script execution results from read-only run.
